text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Phew! I ran my heart out today as well!
My legs've
turned to jelly!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Rice! Where are you off to at such a late
hour?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
B-Bakushin O! Well... I just thought... I'd
go for a
little run...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I want... to do my best like everyone
else...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so-sorry! I'll hurry and be back
before curfew!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh! You're such a hard worker! And
will you
look at your footwork!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful! I'd expect nothing less of
one of my
rivals! Even my jelly legs are
itching with
excitement!

continue to
